## Attendance

The programme board met in January 2024. Present were J. Whitfield, S. Rahman, Priya Anand, R. Adeyemi, L. Petrov. J. Whitfield chaired the meeting.

## Performance

The board reviewed activity for January 2024. The reported total was 2388 captures. Members also considered the current position on outstanding work and correspondence.

The backlog was 257. The number of letters was 53. These figures were noted for monitoring and will provide the basis for review at the next meeting.

The board was satisfied that the available information had been recorded and that the key areas requiring continued oversight had been identified. No further performance information was presented.

## Items

No new incidents or changes were reported. The board considered the position as part of its routine review and noted the need to maintain oversight of captures, the backlog and letters.

Members agreed that any material developments arising between meetings should be brought forward through the usual reporting arrangements.

## Actions

Actions were carried forward to the next meeting. The position on captures, the backlog and letters should be reviewed again, with any changes reflected in the performance update.

The chair asked members to continue monitoring the outstanding work and correspondence and to raise any issues requiring board consideration.
